features: Analog Turbo HD Smart Hybrid Light ColorVu turret — 4-in-1 (TVI/AHD/CVI/CVBS) switchable output over coax; NOT an IP camera
Smart-Hybrid light: up to 20 m white light and 20 m IR
Built-in mic with audio over coaxial cable
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE70DF0T-LPFS is an analog Turbo HD 2MP Smart Hybrid Light ColorVu indoor turret with 24/7 full-color imaging (F1.0), Smart-Hybrid light (20 m white / 20 m IR), built-in mic and 4-in-1 TVI/AHD/CVI/CVBS output over coax. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet (DS-2CE70DF0T-LPFS_Datasheet_20241210.pdf).
